PCA: PCA fit to expanded VAE all_z; inverse_transform with higher PCs zero; not original DQN PCA
power_definition: median(baseline decoded) - median(source-zero decoded), log1p CP10K
KO_rule: x=max(decode(z),0); a=x_IKZF2/reference_IKZF2; xKO_target=max(0,x_target-a*power_IKZF2_target); xKO_IKZF2=0; other genes unchanged
propagation: IKZF2 outgoing response edges once only; no recursive propagation or absolute-value weights
entropy: abundance=expm1(xKO); p=abundance/sum(abundance); H=-sum(p*ln(p)) over all decoder genes
normalized_entropy: H_norm = H / ln(N), N = number of decoder genes; range [0, 1]
validation: PCA roundtrip, scalar calibration, zero-source identity, signed response, unaffected genes, KO zero, independent scipy entropy all passed
caveats: Aggregate response power is not a causal coefficient. Source-amplitude scaling is an assumed approximation, not learned dose-response. GRN is Treg-calibrated and model-derived. Entropy covers 2021 selected features, not the whole transcriptome or uncertainty. No optimized/re-encoded post-KO latent is claimed. 2D hull does not establish 16D support.
